title: Fact Sheet for Nonprofit and Governmental Employers: Reimbursing Financing Terms
content:
Within the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, the reimbursing financing terms — the election window, the minimum years in force, the return notice, the security a nonprofit keeps and the billing of benefits charged — apply only to the two reimbursing classes. In the five contributory classes every one of these figures is 0 or not applicable.

| Financing class | Election window after the liability determination (calendar days) | Minimum full calendar years in force | Notice before 1 January to return to contributory (calendar days) | Security as a share of the prior year's taxable wages | Bill frequency | Bill due after mailing (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contributory — New Employer Standard Rate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Not applicable | 0 |
| Contributory — New Employer Construction Rate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Not applicable | 0 |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Positive Reserve | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Not applicable | 0 |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Deficit Reserve | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Not applicable | 0 |
| Contributory — Delinquent Reporting Assigned Rate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | Not applicable | 0 |
| Reimbursing — Nonprofit Organization | 30 | 2 | 30 | 0.0270 (2.70%) | Quarterly | 30 |
| Reimbursing — Governmental Entity | 30 | 2 | 30 | 0 — none | Quarterly | 30 |

## What each term means

- **Election window** — the calendar days after the liability determination within which an eligible entity may elect reimbursing financing; 0 means not eligible.
- **Minimum years** — the minimum full calendar years an election stays in force; 0 means not applicable.
- **Return notice** — the calendar days before 1 January by which a reimbursing employer must file to return to contributory financing; 0 means not applicable.
- **Security** — the surety bond or deposit a reimbursing employer must keep, as a share of the prior year's taxable wages; 0 means none.
- **Bill frequency and bill due days** — how often a reimbursing employer is billed for benefits charged, and the calendar days after mailing within which the bill must be paid; 0 means not billed.

**Security illustration (hypothetical nonprofit).** A nonprofit in Reimbursing — Nonprofit Organization whose prior-year taxable wages were USD 500000.00 keeps a bond or deposit of 0.0270 of that amount, USD 13500.00. A governmental entity with the same wages keeps none.
